name: OpenJarvis
description: Runs local-first personal AI agents on your own hardware, with a jarvis CLI, starter presets, installable skills, and an OpenAI-compatible local API for developers.

skills.name: Local API Server
skills.description: Serves an OpenAI-compatible chat completions API from your machine with jarvis serve, streaming responses to any OpenAI client.

skills.name: Deep Research
skills.description: Researches a question in multiple hops across the web and your local documents, then answers with citations.

skills.name: Morning Digest
skills.description: Builds a scheduled daily briefing from your email, calendar, health data, and news, and reads it aloud with text-to-speech.

skills.name: Skill Install
skills.description: Installs agent skills from Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, or any GitHub repo, then optimizes them against your local trace history.

skills.name: External MCP Tools
skills.description: Connects external MCP servers such as GitHub, Slack, or a filesystem server as agent tools with jarvis add or config.toml.
